messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: Memory error
parts:
Just a heads up for the devs that I encountered a scenario where my code parses and compiles fine, but throws a memory error regardless of whether I run it from within R or commandline and regardless of the optimization level. Here's the code: https://gist.github.com/mike-lawrence/5893049

Very likely I've done something highly irregular in the code (I was playing with how far I could push vectorization of my code) to cause this. The error is:

R(1710) malloc: *** error for object 0x10b5d2e70: pointer being freed was not allocated
*** set a breakpoint in malloc_error_break to debug
Abort trap: 6


Mike

--
Mike Lawrence
Graduate Student
Department of Psychology & Neuroscience
Dalhousie University

~ Certainty is (possibly) folly ~
